demo.blockingObservation: At a true narrow browser viewport, the live Demo shell collapses the preview to 10px and the Home canvas to 0px; section-level Demo pixels are therefore not visible or honestly crop-able.

classificationLegend.true-reflow: layout geometry changes and content remains readable inside the viewport
classificationLegend.scale: desktop composition is proportionally reduced without semantic rearrangement
classificationLegend.overflow: content exceeds its section or viewport bounds
classificationLegend.collapsed: available width is reduced to zero or near-zero

source.notes: Compact 64.5px header, 141.4×36.5 logo, full-width hero; inactive carousel slides are cropped while the document remains 390px wide.

checks.reason: No visible Demo navigation or Hero exists at the audited narrow viewport.

source.notes: Heading wraps within a 332.8px box with 28.6px side inset; content remains full-width and readable.

checks.reason: The desktop-shell phone mockup shows a scaled Welcome, but the same narrow browser viewport collapses it completely.

source.notes: News rows reflow to mobile geometry; New Arrival remains a masked horizontal rail with 166.4px items, not an accidental document overflow.

checks.reason: No same-viewport visible News or New Arrival pixels; column-to-row and touch-target behavior cannot be compared.

source.notes: Products categories become stacked rows; Events become vertically stacked 373.4px-wide rows with image/text composition and mobile spacing.

checks.reason: No same-viewport visible Products, Events, Schedule, Recommend, or Videos; true reflow versus scale/crop cannot be demonstrated.

checks.reason: Prior phone-mockup evidence suggests the Footer adapts, but the live Demo at the same narrow browser viewport exposes zero-width Home content, so this run cannot award a same-viewport PASS.

earliestEvidenceGap.gap: The live Demo has no auditable Home surface at a true narrow browser viewport because the preview collapses before any section breakpoint can be observed.
earliestEvidenceGap.requiredClosure: Expose the Home canvas at non-zero width in a 390px-class viewport, then recapture all sections at the exact same CSS viewport and measure touch targets and per-section overflow.
